Officer's narrative
On arrival, I found a rear-end collision involving two vehicles at an intersection in League City, Texas. Driver 1 was
stopped in the travel lane when the vehicle oeprated by Driver 2 struck its rear bumper. Driver 2 reported a wrist
fracture and was treated at the scene before being transported for further care. Driver 1 said the impact was sudden
and that the vehicle was stationary at the time. A Passenger seated in the front right seat of Driver 1's vehicle was
also present and corroborated the account. I confirmed that Driver 2 was in the vheicle at the time of the collision.
Damage to both vehicles is consistent with the described impact, and photographs taken at the scene show the
damage locations I observed. I found no earlier damage to either vehicle. No independent witnesses were located.
Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Based on my observations, the injury
reported by Driver 2 is consistent with a collision of this type.
